message.content: {"caption":"AppWorld learning-curve comparison of a baseline and four attribution settings across training progress.","description":"A line chart plots Avg@8 (%) vertically against Training Steps (%) horizontally. The x-axis runs from 0 to 100 in increments of 10, and the y-axis is marked from 20 to 60; values below 20 are also plotted. Five series are identified in the legend: a dashed gray line with circular markers for Baseline; purple squares for Attributing α = 0.05; magenta triangles for Attributing α = 0.10; coral diamonds for Attributing α = 0.20; and orange diamonds for Attributing α = 0.30. All series start near 18. The baseline rises gradually, with a small dip around 50 steps, and ends near 54. The α = 0.05 series rises to about 37 by 20 steps, reaches a local high near 55 at 60 steps, and finishes highest at about 59. The α = 0.10 series climbs quickly to about 51 by 40 steps, fluctuates around 48–52 thereafter, and ends near 59. The α = 0.20 series also rises quickly, levels near 50 through the middle, and finishes around 58. The α = 0.30 series makes the fastest early gain, reaching about 33 at 10 steps and 43 at 20, but fluctuates later and falls to about 44 at the end. Point values are estimated from the plotted marks; no numerical data labels are
